Before the tower, there was only the Stairworld. 🏰

Floating steps, endless sky - and deep below, something cold just woke up. ❄️

The Freeze is coming. Are you climbing?

#towerrush #indiegame #pixelart #16bit #gamelore #indiedev #mobilegame #retrogaming #gamedev #comingsoon

Meet HERO 🧢

Red cap, yellow hoodie, zero chill. He's the first one up the tower and the last one to look down.

His motto: "If we stop, we freeze." ❄️

Hero #1 of 4 - who's next? 👀

#towerrush #meetthecharacters #pixelart #pixelcharacter #indiegame #indiedev #mobilegame #characterdesign #gamedev #comingsoon

COMBO x32 🔥

Chain your jumps, keep the rhythm, and the tower rewards you. Break the chain and the Freeze catches up.

What's the highest combo you'd hit? 👇

#towerrush #combo #indiegame #pixelart #mobilegame #arcadegame #retrogaming #indiedev #gamedev #comingsoon

Meet RAPPER 🎤

He doesn't climb the tower - he flows up it. Every jump lands on the beat.

His motto: "Every step's a beat. Don't miss one." 🎵

Hero #2 of 4.

#towerrush #meetthecharacters #pixelart #pixelcharacter #indiegame #indiedev #mobilegame #characterdesign #gamedev #comingsoon

Every step's a beat 🎵

The whole Tower Rush soundtrack is original, made in-house by the dev (who's also a DJ 🎧). The main theme is called "Arcade Groove".

Turn the sound on 🔊

#towerrush #gamemusic #chiptune #originalsoundtrack #indiegame #pixelart #indiedev #gamedev #retrogaming #comingsoon

The lore of Tower Rush 📜

1️⃣ The Stairworld: no ground, no floor, only steps floating in an endless sky.
2️⃣ The Freeze: an ancient crystal that woke up and started climbing. Everything it touches turns to ice.

The only way out is up. ⬆️

Swipe →

#towerrush #gamelore #worldbuilding #pixelart #16bit #indiegame #indiedev #gamedev #retrogame #comingsoon

Meet GEEK 🎧

She calculates every jump before she makes it: angle, speed, hang time. Then she nails it.

Her motto: "Probability of survival: climbing." 🤓

Hero #3 of 4.

#towerrush #meetthecharacters #pixelart #pixelcharacter #indiegame #indiedev #mobilegame #characterdesign #gamedev #comingsoon

Spot the frozen stairs? Use them. 🧊

Some floors in Tower Rush hide giant ice staircases - land on them and you skip ahead of the Freeze.

Tag a friend who'd miss every one 😅

#towerrush #gameplay #indiegame #pixelart #mobilegame #platformer #retrogaming #indiedev #gamedev #comingsoon

Meet ALIEN 👽

Nobody knows where he came from. He doesn't seem scared of the Freeze at all. He just keeps looking up.

His line: "Up... is home." 🌌

Hero #4 of 4 - the squad is complete.

#towerrush #meetthecharacters #pixelart #pixelcharacter #indiegame #indiedev #mobilegame #characterdesign #gamedev #comingsoon
